original_question: What should I restock in my stores next week?

original_customer_context.original_question: What should I restock in my stores next week?

refined_task_attribution: Analyst decisions for this investigation; not customer instructions or an incumbent description
refined_task: At close of 2025-11-30 forecast recorded gross fulfilled units for next seven days and supplied lead-time plus review coverage; net against usable stock and timely receipts, add supplied safety stock and round positive needs to supplied minimum/multiple. Produce all supported products at stores, zeros included, and time-phased shortage exceptions. Automate with a configurable local non-LLM command.

decision_proxies.primary: mean absolute error of next-week total recorded units per product at store
decision_proxies.secondary: coverage-horizon absolute error, signed error, sparse demand, origin stability, seasonal stability and target sensitivity
decision_proxies.not_measurable: availability improvements, lost sales, profit, savings or optimal service/excess tradeoff without exposure, historical stock or costs

incumbent: No current method supplied; analytical baseline only, no exact incumbent comparison possible.
source_facts: Four released files only; policy, stock and deliveries are assumed operating facts for the authorized scenario. Their source Provenance values remain synthetic in internal evidence. Sales partition has derived release hash distinct from original. No December sales read.
supported_interpretations: Policy supports lead-time-plus-review order-up-to calculation; it does not prescribe a forecasting model.
Stock is an end-of-planning-date position; deliveries are treated as arriving at start of their due day.
Positive completed/shipped/returned units proxy gross stock outflow; no inferred restockable returns.
unresolved_unknowns: Completeness of zero-transaction days and historical assortment exposure are not certified; use explicit conditional complete-extract assumption only after first observed sale.
Old status and return changes have no dated history; development evaluation uses recorded final labels, not a fully reconstructable historical information set.
No customer availability/excess priority, cost function, improvement threshold or precise manual process supplied.
candidate_rationale_sources: input_profile.json and inspect_inputs.py: 336 sparse series, 14-121 transaction rows each across almost four years; every calendar date has some transaction globally.
released/input-1.csv: seven-day review, 1-7 day lead times, integer pack/minimum/safety constraints.
released/input-4.csv: product/store identifiers, dated quantities and repeated seasonal history; no trustworthy historical stock exposure.
candidate_scope: Bounded fixed-parameter recent average, intermittent-demand smoothing and pooled regularized count regression; CPU only. No neural models, heavy ensembles, policy optimization or API calls. Compare once under prospective evaluation_plan.json.
success_gate: Development evidence only; meaningful improvement threshold absent and independent untouched evaluation unavailable. Performance-success recording readiness cannot be established. December remains reserved.
